history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A close-up, eye-level portrait of a middle-aged Southeast Asian man with dark skin, short black hair, and a prominent mustache. He is looking directly at the camera with a thoughtful expression, his right thumb resting on his lower lip and index finger touching his chin. The man is wearing a dark collared shirt. In his right hand, he holds a black smartphone, partially obscuring his face. The background is softly blurred, showing a wooden headboard of a bed and a wooden dresser with a water bottle on top. The lighting is natural and soft, coming from the front, casting subtle shadows that highlight the texture of his skin and the details of his facial features. The color palette is dominated by warm, earthy tones of brown and beige, with the dark clothing and phone providing contrast. The overall mood is introspective and calm.
